notes.title: new "Festival mode" now playable!! ✨creative, make the streaming lively & funny
notes.content:
3 new casual games that allow both streamer and viewers to demonstrate creative and surreal sensibilities with excellent improv comedy, and have fun together (even solo)!


[h2]✨ Pawnishment Cards[/h2]
unlock collection more than 1,000 cards
[h3]Unlock various punishment cards using tickets and edit the title freely. Create your original card deck by registering your favorites![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/726f86c1e3108df267303609dde4e83fb8aacea7.png[/img]
Your favorite cards (Physical, Mental, and Quantum damage) will appear randomly in the board game below.

[h1]✨ Purrgatorium Watcher[/h1]
Card * TurnBase * RogueLite * TowerDefence (4 min /game)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/9d8260fe981e9e6db05c436321575630b7ac658a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/270899a067e51c3f36ef45ce97c6d092706e4c7f.png[/img][/url]　[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/e8db4769854d501553b4567e3a8592ab24e8efd2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/9a3f0be1ec06212f79bf7680dc28916287f03183.png[/img][/url]　[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/771ef1f1abb2aad58a5d87d030334d9f5f1071dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/31c027a91daba825453acce0e5a4ed8b9221060e.png[/img][/url]
[h3]As the judgement of the purgatory between heaven and hell, prevent the escape and invasion of 12 sinners, and become the guardian god in this region (earn tickets, PawLevel++)[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Fo1WSDnpsK8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]✨How to make the Big Winning? (use Trap items)[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Tck-DKPOLoA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ Cosmic Pawâtissier (city building)[/h2]
[h3]Become a creative pastry chef in the heavenly realm and feed mankind with delicious and odd civilized sweets. Alter the history of the region in a chaotic way![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/c070a91243ecce2368e9ae969f594c31a302dec6.png[/img]



[h3]🎮How to play Festival?[/h3]
When visiting some country in [b]Traveling[/b] mode, you will see the [b]Festival[/b] between Tourism and Exorcism.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/8cb17bde581322d512f04e2e6ff1ede3af6b3379.png[/img]


[h3][i]If you feel something, give me some feedback / idea.

Enjoy, paw paw friends![/i][/h3]

notes.title: DLC.1 free patch ✨ (this special benefit has terminated)
notes.content:
The Early Access version you purchased,
[b]already contain DLC.1[/b] which will be sold separately at the time of main release.
[b]You will need to register your activation[/b] with this patch.

Procedure:
(1) update to the latest version v2.6.1~.
(2) Start up the game and enter Story or Traveling mode.
(3) Go back to the Main menu, then you will see a pink "DLC1" sign on the right.

Please do this by the end of February 2024.
(*this special benefit has terminated.)

Other
* Contents refined
✨ 'Full screen' / 'Window screen' via the Inventory Settings

notes.title: Memory 6 ability "LedgeHang" (Update v2.5.4+)
notes.content:
if you missed the Memory 6 ability "LedgeHang" and clear the stage, couldn't proceed Story mode.
[Fixed] it will automatically can use the ability now.
Jump to wall hook(Sun-Moon/L icon), it will automatically grab it.

After Memory 7, you can go down in the Story Tree. 
After Memory 11, go down more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/4ec4f527dbf59bfc337d4552ffb32cccfe60b3a6.png[/img]
